# pnpm 12: workspaces, catalogs, supply-chain security and release management

Honest caveats: generated from the pnpm repo docs as of 2026-09-25 — pnpm v12 is a Rust rewrite keeping v11's commands, flags and lockfile format, but a handful of v12 behaviors differ (check the migration reference); the config-model change matters (settings in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `.npmrc` for auth only, `package.json` `pnpm` field no longer read).
